handoff.currentState: The deterministic domain-rule layer for the opening through the first paid Undo is committed locally as a release candidate. Production and GitHub Pages still run c7ce8f7; this candidate has not been pushed or deployed.
latestFixes: The newest visible scene image is generated before older queued scenes, so rapid choices do not accumulate invisible image work ahead of the current loader.
An interrupted generating image is restored to queued on reload; each attempt has a 60-second cap and preserves its idempotent request id for recovery.
Little Remnant and Default Seven are hidden until a visible character_update or party_change introduces them.
Little Remnant now visibly appears as a nonhuman unfinished paper-bird creature, explains its name, and becomes the guide before any choice may address it.
AI-generated character debuts must follow visible form, name source, present relationship, then interaction choices.
One Undo Key now owns three derived uses; legacy count=3 is normalized to one item.
Twelve local domain rules atomically govern the first routes, first clue, Little Remnant debut, and paid versus free Undo while leaving ordinary free actions open to AI narration.
Home-clue milestones derive from stable inventory ids, and governed next choices are installed locally instead of accepted from model protocol output.
handoff.saveCompatibility: Existing saves remain compatible. A save already beyond Little Remnant's debut will not replay the rewritten introduction; use Restart to review it. Pre-debut legacy saves have incorrectly preloaded hidden characters removed during normalization. Legacy Undo Key count=3 is normalized to one item and its remaining-use metric is reconstructed from undo-key-uses.
